title: A BLESSING THAT CANNOT BE REVERSED

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "I have received a command to bless; he has blessed, and I cannot change it. No misfortune is seen in Jacob, no misery observed in Israel. The LORD their God is with them; the shout of the King is among them." - Num 23:20-21 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Balaam confesses that he is powerless to reverse what God has done. He has received a command to bless, and he cannot change it. God has blessed Israel, and no hired prophet, no angry king, no elaborate ritual can undo it. The blessing is fixed, unchangeable, sealed by God Himself.

Then comes a wonderful declaration: the Lord their God is with them, and the shout of the King is among them. Israel's blessedness flowed from God's presence. He had not abandoned them to face their enemies alone. The King of heaven dwelt in their midst, and that made all the difference.

We should notice that this was true despite Israel's many failures. Balaam says no misery is observed in Israel, not because they were sinless, but because God had covered them with His covenant grace. Their standing rested on His presence and promise, not on their perfect record.

The greatest blessing of the gospel is that God is with us. In Christ, whose name is Immanuel, "God with us," the Lord dwells among His people and within them by His Spirit (Matt 1:23). No power can reverse the blessing God has spoken over those who are in Christ. Take heart: your King is among you, and He will never leave.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you live in the confidence that God is with you?
2. How does God's presence change the way you face your enemies or fears?
3. What does it mean that your blessing in Christ cannot be reversed?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You that You are with me and that the blessing You have spoken in Christ cannot be undone. Help me to walk in the confidence of Your abiding presence. Amen.
